sn35.238:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhu āmantesi bhikkhavoti. bhadanteti te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca: seyyathāpi bhikkhave cattāro āsivisā uggatejā ghoravisā.
sn35.238:1.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo,
sn35.238:1.4: “ime te ambho purisa, cattāro āsivisā uggatejā ghoravisā kālenakālaṃ vuṭṭhāpetabbā, kālena kālaṃ nahāpetabbā, kālena kālaṃ bhojetabbā, kālena kālaṃ saṃvesetabbā;
sn35.238:1.5: yadā ca kho te ambho purisa, imesaṃ catunnaṃ āsivisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ aññataro vā aññataro vā kuppissati: tato tvaṃ ambho purisa maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ:
sn35.238:1.6: yante ambho, purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohī”ti.
sn35.238:2.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnaṃ āsivisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ yena vā tena vā palāyetha.
sn35.238:2.3: ime te ambho purisa, pañcavadhakā paccatthikā piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā yattheva naṃ passissāma tattheva jīvitā voropessāmāti;
sn35.238:2.4: yante ambho purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti.
sn35.238:3.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnaṃ āsivisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ, bhīto pañcannaṃ vadhakānaṃ paccatthikānaṃ yena vā tena vā palāyetha.
sn35.238:3.3: ayaṃ te ambho purisa chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhittāsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddho yattheva naṃ passissāmi tattheva siro pātessāmīti
sn35.238:3.4: yante ambho purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti.
sn35.238:4.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnaṃ āsivisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ, bhīto pañcannaṃ vadhakānaṃ paccatthikānaṃ bhīto, chaṭṭhassa antaracarassa vadhakassa ukkhittāsikassa yena vā tena vā palāyetha.
sn35.238:4.3: yaññadeva gharaṃ paviseyya rittakaññeva paviseyya, tucchakaññeva paviseyya, suññakaññeva paviseyya.
sn35.238:4.4: yaññadeva bhājanaṃ parimaseyya, rittakaññeva parimaseyya tucchakaññeva parimaseyya suññakaññeva parimaseyya.
sn35.238:4.6: idānambho purisa, imaṃ suññaṃ gāmaṃ corā gāmaghātakā vadhissanti,
sn35.238:4.7: yante ambho purisa, karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti.
sn35.238:5.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnaṃ āsivisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ, bhīto pañcannaṃ vadhakānaṃ paccatthikānaṃ, bhīto chaṭṭhassa antaracarassa vadhakassa ukkhittāsikassa, bhīto corānaṃ gāmaghātakānaṃ yena vā tena vā palāyetha.
sn35.238:5.2: so passeyya mahantaṃ udakaṇṇavaṃ, orimaṃtīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ pārimaṃtīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ.
sn35.238:5.3: natthassa nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā aparāparaṃ gamanāya.
sn35.238:5.4: atha kho bhikkhave tassa purisassa evamassa:
sn35.238:5.5: ‘ayaṃ kho mahāudakaṇṇāvo, orimañca tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, pārimaṃtīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ, natthi ca nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā aparāparaṃ gamanāya.
sn35.238:5.6: yannūnāhaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṃkaḍḍhitvā kullaṃ bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ gaccheyyanti.’
sn35.238:6.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṃkaḍḍhitvā kullaṃ bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ gaccheyya, tiṇṇo pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
sn35.238:7.1: upamā kho myāyaṃ bhikkhave, katā atthassa viññāpanatthāya,
sn35.238:7.3: cattāro āsivisā uggatejā ghoravisāti kho bhikkhave, catunnetaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ adhivacanaṃ,
sn35.238:8.1: pañca vadhakā paccatthikāti kho bhikkhave, pañcannetaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyathidaṃ –
sn35.238:9.1: chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhittāsikoti kho bhikkhave, nandirāgassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:10.1: suñño gāmoti kho bhikkhave, channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:10.2: cakkhuto cepi naṃ bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī upaparikkhati, rittakaññeva khāyati, tucchakaññeva khāyati, suññakaññeva khāyati. sotato cepi naṃ bhikkhave …pe… ghānato cepi naṃ bhikkhave …pe…
sn35.238:10.3: jivhāto cepi naṃ bhikkhave …pe… kāyato cepi naṃ bhikkhave …pe…
sn35.238:10.4: manato cepi naṃ bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī upaparikkhati; rittakaññeva khāyati, tucchakaññeva khāyati, suññakaññeva khāyati.
sn35.238:11.1: corā gāmaghātakāti kho bhikkhave, channetaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:12.1: mahāudakaṇṇavoti kho bhikkhave, catunnetaṃ oghānaṃ adhivacanaṃ:
sn35.238:13.1: orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayanti kho bhikkhave sakkāyassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:14.1: pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayanti kho bhikkhave, nibbānassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:15.1: kullanti kho bhikkhave, ariyassetaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyathidaṃ:
sn35.238:15.2: sammādiṭṭhiyā sammāsaṅkappassa sammāvācāya sammākammantassa, sammāājīvassa, sammāvāyāmassa,
sn35.238:16.1: sammāsatiyā, sammāsamādhissa. hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamānoti kho bhikkhave viriyārambhassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:17.1: tiṇṇo pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇoti kho bhikkhave, arahato etaṃ adhivacananti.
